error[ZBX-E0406]: no schema for that command
  while  looking up a schema
  cause  'explain' has no JSON schema; the commands with one are run, bundle,
         ps, stop, doctor, and store-import, store-ls, store-du and store-rm
  arg    explain
  fix    print one:   zbx schema ps
  more   zbx explain E0406
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0406.html
